_comment: Shared competency model (Milestone 5). One identifier per competency is used by question retrieval, the evaluator, the interview agent and the improvement plan. 'skill:<name>' ids use the canonical skill names from skills.txt / skill_catalog.json; 'behavior:<name>' ids are the behavioral competencies tagged on behavioral questions. 'description' is a short plain-language summary used for semantic retrieval; 'related' lists neighbouring competencies used to expand queries (a related skill is never treated as proof of the skill itself).
